scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/pickier-plugin build
scripts.fresh: bunx rimraf node_modules/ bun.lock packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist && bun i
scripts.release: bun --bun run changelog:generate && bunx --bun bumpx prompt --recursive
scripts.release:patch: bun --bun run changelog:generate && bunx --bun bumpx patch --yes --recursive
scripts.release:minor: bun --bun run changelog:generate && bunx --bun bumpx minor --yes --recursive
scripts.release:major: bun --bun run changelog:generate && bunx --bun bumpx major --yes --recursive
